name: drover
author: Aman Sharma Dev
description: Herd-level model routing with Gemini EAP tool retrieval for VS Code Insiders.

enumDescriptions: Coding Expert - software engineering, code generation and review
Reverse Engineering Expert - assembly, decompilers, ELF/PE analysis
Binary Exploitation Expert - buffer overflows, ROP chains, pwntools
Web Security Expert - XSS, SQLi, SSRF, web vulnerabilities
Malware Analysis Expert - triage, IOC extraction, behavioral analysis
Cryptography Expert - CTF crypto, cipher analysis, encoding
Linux Expert - system admin, shell scripting, internals
Writing Expert - reports, documentation, creative writing
Documentation Expert - READMEs, API docs, technical guides
Learning Expert - explanations, tutorials, concept breakdowns
drover.defaultExpert.description: Default expert profile when opening a new chat.

drover.streamResponses.description: Stream responses token by token as they arrive.

enumDescriptions: Default - Prompt for approval on all modifying operations (human-in-the-loop)
Bypass - Automatically approve all tool and command executions
Autopilot - Automatically approve all tool executions and run autonomously
drover.approvalMode.description: Approval mode for workspace tools and terminal commands.

enumDescriptions: Default - Automatically select mode based on request commands or user intent classification
Ask - Conversational support mode (equivalent to /ask, no tool execution)
Plan - Plan formulation mode (equivalent to /plan, generates implementation plans)
Agent - Autonomous agent mode (equivalent to /agent, executes tasks using tools)
drover.defaultMode.description: Default mode of operation when no slash command is explicitly entered in chat.

drover.maxAutoFixRetries.description: Maximum number of automatic self-correction retries when a terminal command fails. Set to 0 to disable the auto-fix loop.

drover.autoGenerateCommitMessageOnSave.description: Automatically generate a suggested commit message and git diff summary when files are saved.

drover.customInstructions.description: Custom instructions to personalize ModelPilot chat and inline code generation responses (e.g., coding style guidelines, project preferences).

drover.local.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the local llama.cpp / llama-swap server

drover.local.model.description: Preferred model ID on the local server

drover.nimlocal.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the local NVIDIA NIM proxy

drover.nimlocal.model.description: Preferred model ID on the NIM proxy
